title: Copy a register value
summary: Assembly: Copy a register value. Put 8 in rbx.
introduction: mov copies a value. It does not erase the source register. Read the example, then check the result.
learningObjectives: Copy a register value with Assembly

blocks.text: On x86-64 Linux, save lesson.asm. Run nasm -f elf64 lesson.asm -o lesson.o, then ld lesson.o -o lesson. Run ./lesson, then printf 'exit code: %s\n' "$?" immediately.

blocks.title: Copy a register value
blocks.code:
global _start
section .text
_start:
    mov rbx, 3
    mov rdi, rbx
    mov rax, 60
    syscall

blocks.text: rbx first receives 3. Copying it into rdi passes 3 to exit.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: The destination comes first in NASM syntax.
